abstract: A 7-month-old infant showed bilateral enlarged, nontender scrotal masses. The level of alpha-fetoprotein was greater than 10,000 ng/ml preoperatively; a high left inguinal orchiectomy was performed for a suspected yolk-sac tumor. The right testis was diagnosed as a mature teratoma because it was not possible to establish a line of cleavage between the tumor and the normal tissue, and a high right inguinal orchiectomy was performed. Only one case of bilateral testicular teratomas has been reported in the literature to date. We report a rare second case of bilateral testicular tumors, one a yolk-sac tumor and the other a teratoma.
abstract_ja: 7か月の乳児が両側の陰嚢腫瘤を示し、いずれも無痛性であった。術前のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は10,000 ng/mlを超えていた。卵黄嚢腫瘍が疑われ左側の高位精巣摘除術を施行した。右精巣は腫瘍と正常組織の間に分離面を確認できず成熟奇形腫と診断され、右鼠径部からの高位精巣摘除術を施行した。両側精巣奇形腫の報告は文献上これまでに1例のみである。本稿では、一方が卵黄嚢腫瘍、他方が奇形腫である両側精巣腫瘍の稀な2例目を報告する。
